posts.name: Val
posts.cooked:
This is derailing into a holiday topic and food. I might as well add. We don't have Thanksgiving here in the Netherlands either, obviously. But we do have something called 'Sinterklaas'. The guy from Canada was joking with his moose meat and such, but what I'm about to tell about 'Sinterklaas' is dead serious. No joke.

Sinterklaas is the patron saint of children. He was born in Myra, Turkey. He's kind of like a mix of Santa Claus and the tooth fairy. He comes from Spain (not the North Pole) and every year he takes a boat from Spain to the Netherlands (yeah, he gets around) to celebrate his birthday here, which is on the 6th of december. His boat arrives a few weeks before that date. From the moment he arrives, children can put a shoe (filled with hay or carrots or sugar for the horse) at the chimney (or somewhere else if you don't have a chimney). At night, Sinterklaas rides on his white mare over the roofs, and drops small presents in those shoes.

He's being helped by 'Zwarte Pieten' ('Black Peters'), which are black servants. Yes, this is getting weird, and this probably (there are a few different theories) stems from our history, with Spain as our arch enemy in the 80 Year War (1568-1648), and the Moors (black North Africans) helping/serving the Spaniards in trying to kill us. Anyway. On the 6th of December is the 'grand finale'. Then he drops the big gifts through the chimney. Much like the gifts under the Christmas tree. But then around your shoes.

Adults usually celebrate his birthday on the 5th of december in the evening, with exchanging gifts which are wrapped in creative packages, accompanied by little rhymes to describe the contents of the package or the person who gets the package. It sometimes leads to some very akward and embarrassing moments. Luckily, in this day and age, we have 'rhyme generators' which you can freely use to generate rhymes for you.

The sweets that go with this are 'pepernoten' and 'speculaas'. Both are made from cookie dough and the dough contains some very typical herbs with a very distinct flavour .

His boat arrived last Saturday, so the whole circus is in full swing now.

posts.name: LCinn

It's not that different from Santa Claus, though some specifics differ.

Also note that the Zwarte Pieten look pretty much like what Americans know as black-face, to the horror of unsuspecting American tourists :P it's not really the same (at least not anymore); I know that I as a child never made the link between Zwarte Pieten and actual dark skin. I think it's because as a child you think the Zwarte Pieten are real, and they look completely different from people with actual dark skin (obviously), so they're clearly not connected whatsoever! Zwarte Pieten got like they are because they go down chimneys all the time during training, and they have amazing flexibility and balance, and were pretty much supernatural fairytale characters to me and everyone else I know. posts.cooked:
Back of the envelope math:

We are currently at $125410 with 1811 backers.

Assuming that international backers represent a little more than 10% of this number (call it 200 international backers).  Let's also assume that all 200 of those international backers have already backed for ST, Vengeance, and have paid one shipping charge.  (Eliminating the international backers just makes it a little easier to do the fast math.  See the note at the bottom of this post).

 

These assumptions would mean that there are 1611 domestic backers who have pledged $97410 collectively for an average of $60.47 per backer.    If every backer was in for ST and Vengeance, we would expect the average to be around $70 per backer.  

 

Bottom line: my math indicates that somewhere between 350 and 400 backers have not pledged for Vengeance yet.  If those backers pledged for Vengeance, we would hit $141k instantly.

 

Note: I essentially removed the international backers and those who have pledged for additional items.  When these are factored in, it actually indicates that my estimate of how many have not yet backed Vengeance is too low.  We may have upwards of 500 backers who have not adjusted their pledge to get Vengeance.  It is entirely possible that if everyone who has not pledged for Vengeance does so, we will hit the $150k mark instantly.
